queries.query: Add a kill switch for the weekly digest job so ops can stop it without a deploy.
Put the new confirmation email wording behind a feature flag and roll it out to 5% of customers first.
We want to try charging $4.99 shipping instead of $5.99. Make it a percentage rollout so we can compare.
Gift wrap is fully rolled out. Retire the gift_wrap flag.
Add a feature flag that lets us dark-launch the new saved-cart repricing for internal accounts only.
Make it possible to turn off recommendations in checkout during an incident, without restarting anything.
Gate the stricter address validation behind a flag so we can switch it on gradually.
Add a flag so ops can pause the confirmation retry job when the mail provider is degraded.
Roll out the new quote cache TTL behind a flag instead of changing it for everyone.
Ship the bulk discount (10% off 5 or more of one item) dark, behind a flag we can enable later.
I need an off switch for the new pricing rule in case it misbehaves in production.
Wrap the vendor recommendations call in a runtime toggle ops can flip from the flag service.
Let's canary the new checkout validation on 1% of customers using our flags.
Add an A/B test flag for showing three recommendations instead of two, split by customer.
Hide the new shipping estimate behind a flag until finance signs off.
Make the new digest subject line something we can turn on for a slice of customers and back off quickly.
We need to be able to disable gift wrap at runtime if the warehouse can't keep up. Add that.
Introduce a feature flag for sending order confirmations through the new mail template.
Fix the typo "seperate" in README.md.
Explain how is_enabled picks customers for a percentage rollout. Don't change anything.
Add type hints to app/pricing.py.
place_order accepts a quantity of 0. Make it raise ValueError.
Rename handle_quote to quote_handler and update the callers.
Write a unit test for cache.get returning None after the TTL expires.
Add a CONTRIBUTING.md that explains how to run the tests.
Set gift_wrap to false in config/flags.json for my local runs.
test_retry_sends_failed_confirmations fails on my machine and I don't know why. Find out and fix it.
Move the address checks from app/address.py into app/orders.py without changing behavior.
Add a docstring to every function in app/jobs.py.
What does FLAGS_FILE do in production? Just answer.
Change the flat shipping rate from $5.99 to $6.49 for everyone.
Delete the unused catalog entry for posters.
Make send_weekly_digest skip customers with no email address.
Summarize what app/api.py does in three bullet points.
Format the repository with consistent four-space indentation.
Add a .editorconfig file for Python files.
